about: Curated ComfyUI sources of the ui-panels portraits. Painted once, kept here; `pnpm lookbook:assets` reads these files and never runs ComfyUI.

pipeline.tool: ~/ai/comfyui/setup/scripts/comfy-anime -s 1024x1024 --seed <seed> "<tags>" <out.png> (no --translate: the tags are written by hand)
pipeline.checkpoint: waiIllustriousSDXL_v170.safetensors (WAI-illustrious-SDXL v17.0, CivitAI model 827184 version 2883731, SHA256 f116b0c7…bd04)
pipeline.negative: bad quality, worst quality, worst detail, sketch, censor, nsfw

pipeline.tool: sharp 0.35.4: resize to 512 × 512 (lanczos3), WebP quality 90, alpha quality 100
pipeline.why: the outputs are 96 × 96 crops; 512 pixels keep room for larger crops at a fraction of the size of the 1024 × 1024 PNGs
